### split none 
```{r}
none_data<- tbl(con,"visits_nlp_tier1") %>% 
  select(contains(c('Rno')), visit_id) %>% 
  collect
  
```

```{r}
none_data <- none_data %>% 
  select_if(function(x) !all(is.na(x))) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(-visit_id, is.na))
```

### get middle names 

```{r}
none_assessment_values <- none_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(!visit_id, names_to = "assessment", values_to = "score") %>% 
  extract(
    col = assessment,
    into = c("first", "middle", "last"),
    regex = "^([^_]+)_(.*)_([^_]+)$"
  ) %>% 
  select(middle) %>% 
  unique()

```


```{r}
positions <- data.frame(none_assessment_values$middle)
```


### put all middle names into columns to reduce width --> spagetti codeee 
```{r}
positions <- none_assessment_values$middle

pattern <- paste0(
  ".*_(",
  paste(positions, collapse = "|"),
  ")_.*"
)

none_condensed <- none_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(.x, "NA"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches(pattern),
    names_to = "position",
    names_pattern = pattern,
    values_to = "value",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  group_by(visit_id, position) %>%
  summarise(
    value = list(as.double(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = position,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.list),
      ~ lapply(.x, function(x) {
        if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x
      })
    )
  )

```


### extract only the rows with lists in them <- 116
```{r}
position_cols <- intersect(positions, names(none_condensed))

none_two_or_more_rows <- none_condensed %>%
  filter(if_any(
    all_of(position_cols),
    ~ lengths(.x) > 1
  )) %>% 
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x)))) %>% 
  select(where(~ !all(.x == "NULL")))
  
```

### extract the rows with only 1 input
```{r}
only_one_none <- none_condensed %>%
  filter(if_any(
    all_of(position_cols),
    ~ all(lengths(.x) == 1)
  )) %>% 
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x)))) %>% 
  select(
    where(~ !is.character(.x) )
  )

visit_one_none <- only_one_none %>% 
  select(visit_id)

visit_two_or_more_rows <- none_two_or_more_rows%>% 
  select(visit_id)

```

### theres a total of  286 participants  whats being doubled 
```{r}
setdiff(visit_one_none, visit_two_or_more_rows  )
```

 
### theres a total of  286 participants  whats being doubled 
```{r}
inner_join(visit_two_or_more_rows, visit_one_none  ) %>%  View
```
